config log syslogd setting
    set status enable
    set server "203.0.113.253"
    set mode udp
    set port 514
    set facility local7
    set source-ip-interface ''
    set source-ip ''
    set format default
    set priority default
    set max-log-rate 0
    set interface-select-method auto
    set vrf-select 0
end
